_doc: Damage numbers (spec 24, owner correction 2026-10-21), read by scripts/ui/combat_fx.gd. A number pops in (pop_from -> 1.0 over pop_s), then grows to expand_to while its opacity falls to 0 by life_s, and floats up rise_lines number-heights over its whole life, easing out. size_px is a normal number at 1.0x on the 1600x900 canvas; phone canvases (UiTokens.is_compact) multiply it by compact_scale. A hit is 'big' when it takes at least big_hit_frac of the target's max HP. Quick hits on one target take the nearest spot beside it where they stay pad_px clear of its readable numbers (alpha >= visible_alpha) for their whole path. Every value is an ASSUMPTION until the owner tunes it.
